'''Logan Pietig''' (GEMP handle '''Logan_RMS''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> finished '''3rd''' (tie) in [[2025 Retro League Event 3|Event 3 of the 2025 Retro League]].<ref name="p1439242" /> Pietig also finished '''#3''' at the [[2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix]].<ref name="pc-2025LasVegasGrandPrix" /> Pietig also finished '''#30''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 32).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
